title: Demand Compression & Opportunity Canvas for Strategic Accounts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight, repeatable canvas that Sales and Customer Success can use to compress multiple enterprise feature asks into prioritized opportunity profiles. The canvas should produce: (1) a one-page value hypothesis that quantifies revenue/profit path and implementation complexity, (2) a tier recommendation (Quick Win / Strategic / Not Feasible), and (3) a short product riser with clear asks for Eng/Design. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-scope from days to <48 hours and improve triage consistency across global account teams.
background: We receive a high volume of account-specific feature asks that repeat across accounts in different permutations. Current intake is ad hoc and creates review churn between PM, Eng, and Solutions. This initiative targets the Sales/CS to PM handoff: a structured canvas + simple scoring will let PMs batch-scope and rapidly estimate economic impact. This complements the existing enterprise intake playbooks but focuses on compressing overlapping asks into investable opportunity clusters.
acceptance_criteria: A templated canvas (Google Slides) with defined fields for problem statement, impacted personas, proxied adoption metric, estimated ARR uplift, implementation complexity, and security/regulatory flags
A lightweight scoring rubric that yields a Tier recommendation with documented thresholds
Pilot run with 6 strategic accounts completed and 80% of pilot inputs usable for immediate first-pass scoping
Handoff checklist to engineering that includes example data, required integrations, and a recommended rollout strategy

decisions: Use percentile-based ARR uplift buckets (Top 5%, Top 20%, Top 50%, Rest) instead of attempting precise ARR modeling for initial scoping
Tier outputs will be Quick Win / Strategic / Requires Investigation / Low Priority
Security/regulatory flags will route into a mandatory pre-check step rather than blocking initial scoping
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sales teams may game scores to escalate demand. Mitigation: require supporting evidence (usage stats, pilot commitments, exec champion) and sample verification by Solutions.
Risk: Engineering capacity unknown could produce false Quick Wins. Mitigation: attach a conservative complexity multiplier and validate with Eng on a weekly triage call.
Risk: Overlap with existing intake artifacts. Mitigation: map canvas fields to canonical intake fields and include a 'derived from' pointer to existing ticket or PRD.

% of pilot inputs tagged as 'usable for scoping' (target >= 80%)
Estimated ARR bucket alignment with Revenue's internal score (target >= 70% agreement)
Reduction in duplicate asks surfaced to Eng (target 40% less duplicates for piloted accounts)
